name: University of Michigan
meets_full_need_notes: The University of Michigan, as a public university, does not guarantee to meet 100% of demonstrated financial need. Average need met is approximately 80% for domestic students. Michigan residents receive significantly better aid through the Go Blue Guarantee.
no_loan_notes: The University of Michigan does not have a no-loan policy. Loans are standard components of most aid packages. The Go Blue Guarantee covers full tuition for Michigan residents with family incomes under $65,000.

merit_thresholds.notes: University of Michigan offers several competitive merit scholarships: the Stamps Scholarship (full-ride), Hail Scholarship (full tuition), and LSA Merit Scholarships. The Stamps Scholarship is the flagship award, covering all costs for four years.

ed_aid_implications: University of Michigan offers Early Action (non-binding). Applying EA does not affect financial aid awards. All students are considered for merit scholarships regardless of application plan.
special_programs: Go Blue Guarantee (full tuition for MI residents under $65k income)
appeal_policy: University of Michigan students may appeal their financial aid package through the Office of Financial Aid by submitting a Special Circumstances Appeal form with supporting documentation.
